say:0:1821601001:0.text: I... I've never dealt with anything like this either...
say:0:1821601001:0.source_cn: 这……我也没碰到过这种事……

say:1:1821601002:0.text: I don't care! Just think of something!

say:2:1821603002:1.text: Come on, help me give Morrie the scolding he deserves!
say:2:1821603002:1.source_cn: 快，快帮我一起骂莫里这个家伙！
say:2:1821603002:1.male: Come on, help me give Morrie the scolding he deserves!
say:2:1821603002:1.female: Come on, help me give Morrie the scolding he deserves!

say:3:1821603003:1.text: W-wait! Why am I in trouble? I haven't done anything!

say:4:1821603004:1.text: Exactly! People are getting sick, and you've done nothing!
say:4:1821603004:1.source_cn: 就是因为你什么都没做，所以才有错！

choice_prompt:5:1821603004.text: Exactly! People are getting sick, and you've done nothing!
choice_prompt:5:1821603004.source_cn: 就是因为你什么都没做，所以才有错！

say:6:1821603005:1.text: Ugh, why did Bantus have to lock down the whole city? Now all of us who smuggled ourselves in from the Lightbearer Empire are trapped here, hiding from the authorities!
say:6:1821603005:1.source_cn: 都怪班题斯，没事搞什么全城戒严！害得我们这些偷渡过来的...
say:6:1821603005:1.male: Ugh, why did Bantus have to lock down the whole city? Now all of us who smuggled ourselves in from the Lightbearer Empire are trapped here, hiding from the authorities!
say:6:1821603005:1.female: Ugh, why did Bantus have to lock down the whole city? Now all of us who smuggled ourselves in from the Lightbearer Empire are trapped here, hiding from the authorities!

say:7:1821603006:0.text: The lockdown is finally over, but the dock is still closed. Not even Deadreef Shipping can get a ship out.
say:7:1821603006:0.source_cn: 好不容易等到戒严解除，码头却还是被封锁着，连暗礁航运的...
say:7:1821603006:0.male: The lockdown is finally over, but the dock is still closed. Not even Deadreef Shipping can get a ship out.
say:7:1821603006:0.female: The lockdown is finally over, but the dock is still closed. Not even Deadreef Shipping can get a ship out.

say:8:1821603007:0.text: Worst of all, people are starting to get sick. Senea and I were terrified, so we turned to Deadreef Shipping, hoping they could get us home.
say:8:1821603007:0.source_cn: 最要命的是，有好多人的身体已经开始不舒服了，我和塞涅知...
say:8:1821603007:0.male: Worst of all, people are starting to get sick. Senea and I were terrified, so we turned to Deadreef Shipping, hoping they could get us home.
say:8:1821603007:0.female: Worst of all, people are starting to get sick. Senea and I were terrified, so we turned to Deadreef Shipping, hoping they could get us home.

say:9:1821603008:0.text: And Morrie's answer? "Sorry, can't help." So much for all those promises about getting every last one of us safely back to the Lightbearer Empire!
say:9:1821603008:0.source_cn: 可是没想到——莫里竟然说他们没办法！亏他之前还信誓旦旦...
say:9:1821603008:0.male: And Morrie's answer? "Sorry, can't help." So much for all those promises about getting every last one of us safely back to the Lightbearer Empire!
say:9:1821603008:0.female: And Morrie's answer? "Sorry, can't help." So much for all those promises about getting every last one of us safely back to the Lightbearer Empire!

say:10:1821603009:1.text: If I'd known Deadreef Shipping was owned by the Syndicate, I'd never have come to Novaris—not even for Senea's memorial show!
say:10:1821603009:1.source_cn: 要是我早知道暗礁航运背后是黑心的黑金商会，就算错过塞涅...
say:10:1821603009:1.male: If I'd known Deadreef Shipping was owned by the Syndicate, I'd never have come to Novaris—not even for Senea's memorial show!
say:10:1821603009:1.female: If I'd known Deadreef Shipping was owned by the Syndicate, I'd never have come to Novaris—not even for Senea's memorial show!

say:11:1821603010:1.text: See? This is exactly why the Syndicate keeps its shipping division independent...
say:11:1821603010:1.source_cn: 你看，这就是为什么商会要单独设立航运部门……

say:13:1821603012:1.text: R-right, sorry... Look, Deadreef Shipping may belong to the Syndicate, but we have standards of our own. We won't leave you stranded.
say:13:1821603012:1.source_cn: 对、对不起……不过你放心，我们暗礁航运虽然是商会的附属...

say:14:1821603013:1.text: I may not have had a plan a while ago, but I do now!
say:14:1821603013:1.source_cn: 我刚才只是一时没想到解决办法……但我现在想到了！

choice_prompt:15:1821603013.text: I may not have had a plan a while ago, but I do now!
choice_prompt:15:1821603013.source_cn: 我刚才只是一时没想到解决办法……但我现在想到了！

say:16:1821603015:1.text: Our Novaris branch has several Graveborn doctors who treat the living employees stationed here. One of them should know what to do.
say:16:1821603015:1.source_cn: 诺珐斯分部有好几位亡灵医生，专门为在这里工作的生者提供...

say:17:1821603016:0.text: The building may be gone, but we're still in business. For Deadreef Shipping's good name, I'll drag a doctor here myself if I have to!
say:17:1821603016:0.source_cn: 虽然大楼毁了，但生意还在。为了暗礁航运的名声，就算要用...

choice_prompt:18:1821603016.text: The building may be gone, but we're still in business. For Deadreef Shipping's good name, I'll drag a doctor here myself if I have to!
choice_prompt:18:1821603016.source_cn: 虽然大楼毁了，但生意还在。为了暗礁航运的名声，就算要用拖的，我也把他们拖来！

say:19:1821603017:0.text: Because Deadreef Shipping's reputation depends on—
say:19:1821603017:0.source_cn: 为了暗礁航运的名声，我——

say:20:1821603018:0.text: Yes, yes, your precious reputation. We heard you!
say:20:1821603018:0.source_cn: 啊，好了好了！别再重复了。

say:21:1821603019:1.text: Fine. People need help now, so <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I will trust you one last time. Don't let us down!
say:21:1821603019:1.male: Fine. People need help now, so <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I will trust you one last time. Don't let us down!
say:21:1821603019:1.female: Fine. People need help now, so <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I will trust you one last time. Don't let us down!

say:22:1821603020:1.text: Go get that doctor and bring them to the <style="highlight">Repair House</style>. That's where the sick are staying.
say:22:1821603020:1.source_cn: 快去找你说的医生吧，记得把他带到<style=high...

say:23:1821603021:1.source_cn: 放心吧，我马上就把医生拖过去！

say:25:1821603022:0.text: Come on, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Let's head to the Repair House and wait there.
say:25:1821603022:0.male: Come on, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Let's head to the Repair House and wait there.
say:25:1821603022:0.female: Come on, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Let's head to the Repair House and wait there.

say:26:1821603023:1.text: Let's hope the Syndicate does the right thing for once...
say:26:1821603023:1.source_cn: 但愿黑金商会这次能有点良心……！
say:26:1821603023:1.male: Let's hope the Syndicate does the right thing for once...
say:26:1821603023:1.female: Let's hope the Syndicate does the right thing for once...

choice:18:1:2.text: What makes you so sure we can trust them?
choice:18:1:2.source_cn: 你怎么保证他们靠得住？
choice:18:1:2.male: What makes you so sure we can trust them?
choice:18:1:2.female: What makes you so sure we can trust them?

say:28:1821603014:1.text: It's a real plan! Probably. Either way, it proves I'm taking this very seriously!
say:28:1821603014:1.source_cn: 至少……至少证明了我的服务态度！
say:28:1821603014:1.male: It's a real plan! Probably. Either way, it proves I'm taking this very seriously!
say:28:1821603014:1.female: It's a real plan! Probably. Either way, it proves I'm taking this very seriously!

choice:15:1:2.text: An actual plan, or just another one of your bad ideas?
choice:15:1:2.source_cn: 你想出来的办法可靠吗……
choice:15:1:2.male: An actual plan, or just another one of your bad ideas?
choice:15:1:2.female: An actual plan, or just another one of your bad ideas?

say:0:1821604001:0.text: Let's get to the Repair House. My magic may be able to help until the doctor arrives.
say:0:1821604001:0.source_cn: 去修缮屋等等吧，或许我的魔法也能帮上忙。
say:0:1821604001:0.male: Let's get to the Repair House. My magic may be able to help until the doctor arrives.
say:0:1821604001:0.female: Let's get to the Repair House. My magic may be able to help until the doctor arrives.

say:4:1821605005:0.text: Maybe you just need some sleep...

say:0:1821606001:1.text: The once-quiet Repair House is now packed with sick stowaways, busier than it ever was before the lockdown.
say:0:1821606001:1.source_cn: 冷静已久的修缮屋里挤满了身体不适的偷渡者，远比戒严前更...

say:1:1821606002:1.text: If Baba Muriel were still here, perhaps they wouldn't feel so helpless...
say:1:1821606002:1.source_cn: 如果穆婆婆还在，也许他们就不会这么无助……

say:2:1821606003:1.text: This isn't the time to dwell on the past. Your magic may be able to help them, and you'd rather not leave their lives entirely in the Syndicate's hands.
say:2:1821606003:1.source_cn: ……现在可不是感慨过去的时间。说不定你的魔法可以解决眼...
say:2:1821606003:1.male: This isn't the time to dwell on the past. Your magic may be able to help them, and you'd rather not leave their lives entirely in the Syndicate's hands.
say:2:1821606003:1.female: This isn't the time to dwell on the past. Your magic may be able to help them, and you'd rather not leave their lives entirely in the Syndicate's hands.

say:0:1821607001:0.text: Let's start by <style="highlight">checking on the patients</style>.
say:0:1821607001:0.source_cn: 先去<style=highlight>看看病人们的情况...
say:0:1821607001:0.male: Let's start by <style="highlight">checking on the patients</style>.
say:0:1821607001:0.female: Let's start by <style="highlight">checking on the patients</style>.

say:1:1821608001:1.text: I can't bring myself to do anything... No matter how much I sleep, I'm still tired.
say:1:1821608001:1.source_cn: 唉，干什么都提不起劲，怎么睡都不够……

choice_prompt:2:1821608001.text: I can't bring myself to do anything... No matter how much I sleep, I'm still tired.
choice_prompt:2:1821608001.source_cn: 唉，干什么都提不起劲，怎么睡都不够……

say:3:1821608002:1.text: Not even close... I'm completely exhausted.
say:3:1821608002:1.male: Not even close... I'm completely exhausted.
say:3:1821608002:1.female: Not even close... I'm completely exhausted.

say:4:1821608003:1.text: This was supposed to be a vacation. How did I end up feeling worse than when I arrived...?
say:4:1821608003:1.source_cn: 我明明是来享受假期的，怎么会这么累呢……唉……
say:4:1821608003:1.male: This was supposed to be a vacation. How did I end up feeling worse than when I arrived...?
say:4:1821608003:1.female: This was supposed to be a vacation. How did I end up feeling worse than when I arrived...?

say:6:1821608004:1.text: Why not listen to one of Senea's songs? Or look through her performance photos? That usually cheers you up.
say:6:1821608004:1.source_cn: 那你要不要听听塞涅的歌声，或者看看塞涅的戏剧写真？这样...

say:7:1821608005:0.text: You're her biggest fan! You always get a seat in the front row!
say:7:1821608005:0.source_cn: 你可是塞涅的忠实粉丝，每场演出都买最前排的席位！

say:8:1821608006:1.text: I'm sorry... Senea is beautiful, and I love her voice, but I don't have the energy for any of that...
say:8:1821608006:1.source_cn: 抱歉，塞涅是很美，歌声也很动听，但我真的没有精神做这些事……

say:9:1821608007:1.text: All I want to do is lie here and do absolutely nothing...
say:9:1821608007:1.source_cn: 我现在只想躺着，什么也不做……唉……

choice_prompt:10:1821608007.text: All I want to do is lie here and do absolutely nothing...
choice_prompt:10:1821608007.source_cn: 我现在只想躺着，什么也不做……唉……

say:11:1821608008:0.text: No... and she's not the only one. More and more people are losing all their energy.
say:11:1821608008:0.source_cn: 是啊……有很多人都像她这样，越来越无精打采了。
say:11:1821608008:0.male: No... and she's not the only one. More and more people are losing all their energy.
say:11:1821608008:0.female: No... and she's not the only one. More and more people are losing all their energy.

choice:10:0:1.text: Not even Senea can cheer her up?
choice:10:0:1.source_cn: 竟然连塞涅都不起作用？
choice:10:0:1.male: Not even Senea can cheer her up?
choice:10:0:1.female: Not even Senea can cheer her up?

say:1:1821609001:1.source_cn: 我完蛋了……我真的完蛋了！

say:2:1821609002:1.text: We've been stuck here ever since they put the city under lockdown. It's gone on for so long, and they still won't let us leave!
say:2:1821609002:1.source_cn: 这个破地方竟然戒严了这么久，到现在还不让我们返程！

say:3:1821609003:1.text: Dura above... By the time I get back, all my customers will be gone! I worked so hard to improve my goods and win them over!
say:3:1821609003:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上……等我回去，我的客户估计都要跑光了！我那么卖...

say:4:1821609004:0.text: Stay calm! If your goods are truly that good, your customers may be willing to wait.
say:4:1821609004:0.source_cn: 冷静，请冷静一点！说不定你的客户会看在高品质的份上，等...

say:5:1821609005:0.text: Quality is worth waiting for. Don't assume the worst just yet.
say:5:1821609005:0.source_cn: 毕竟好东西总是值得等待的，不要这么悲观嘛。

say:6:1821609006:1.text: No, you don't understand. My business is finished!
say:6:1821609006:1.source_cn: 不，你不懂……我彻底完蛋了！

say:7:1821609007:1.text: I bought a manor only four months ago, and I haven't even paid it off. I'm going bankrupt...
say:7:1821609007:1.source_cn: 而且我四个月前才刚买了一座庄园，贷款都还没还清……我真...

say:1:1821610001:1.text: Why won't the room stop spinning? Am I sick?
say:1:1821610001:1.source_cn: 我怎么一直头晕眼花……是不是生病了？

say:2:1821610002:1.text: I read about something called "afterlife vertigo" in those medical records—some Graveborn end up with it. What if that's what I'm going through?
say:2:1821610002:1.source_cn: 刚才我在桌上那些病历里看到，有些亡灵会患上往生眩晕症，...

choice_prompt:3:1821610002.text: I read about something called "afterlife vertigo" in those medical records—some Graveborn end up with it. What if that's what I'm going through?
choice_prompt:3:1821610002.source_cn: 刚才我在桌上那些病历里看到，有些亡灵会患上往生眩晕症，我是不是也得了这种病呢……

say:4:1821610003:1.text: What are you talking about? I am Graveborn. I belong here.
say:4:1821610003:1.source_cn: 你在说什么？我是亡灵，才不是偷渡者。
say:4:1821610003:1.male: What are you talking about? I am Graveborn. I belong here.
say:4:1821610003:1.female: What are you talking about? I am Graveborn. I belong here.

say:5:1821610004:0.text: That's Oakly's problem—she genuinely believes she's Graveborn.
say:5:1821610004:0.source_cn: 这就是奥克蕾的症状——她觉得自己是货真价实的亡灵。
say:5:1821610004:0.male: That's Oakly's problem—she genuinely believes she's Graveborn.
say:5:1821610004:0.female: That's Oakly's problem—she genuinely believes she's Graveborn.

say:6:1821610005:0.text: But I swear by Dura, she's alive! Her cabin was right next to mine on the voyage here!
say:6:1821610005:0.source_cn: 但是我向艾雅发誓，她绝对是生者！来诺珐斯的船上，她的房...
say:6:1821610005:0.male: But I swear by Dura, she's alive! Her cabin was right next to mine on the voyage here!
say:6:1821610005:0.female: But I swear by Dura, she's alive! Her cabin was right next to mine on the voyage here!

say:7:1821610006:1.text: If we can't cure her, she may refuse to go home even after the ships are allowed to leave. We can't let that happen!
say:7:1821610006:1.source_cn: 要是没办法治好她，等到可以返程的时候，说不定她都不愿意...
say:7:1821610006:1.male: If we can't cure her, she may refuse to go home even after the ships are allowed to leave. We can't let that happen!
say:7:1821610006:1.female: If we can't cure her, she may refuse to go home even after the ships are allowed to leave. We can't let that happen!

choice:3:0:1.text: But aren't you one of the stowaways?
choice:3:0:1.male: But aren't you one of the stowaways?
choice:3:0:1.female: But aren't you one of the stowaways?

choice:3:1:2.text: You can't catch a disease that only affects the Graveborn.
choice:3:1:2.source_cn: 生者不会患上亡灵的病
choice:3:1:2.male: You can't catch a disease that only affects the Graveborn.
choice:3:1:2.female: You can't catch a disease that only affects the Graveborn.

say:0:1821611001:1.text: After speaking with the patients, you sense the same problem in each of them—the magic inside their bodies has fallen badly out of balance.
say:0:1821611001:1.source_cn: 经过短暂的接触，你察觉到这些生病的偷渡者体内都有魔力紊...
say:0:1821611001:1.male: After speaking with the patients, you sense the same problem in each of them—the magic inside their bodies has fallen badly out of balance.
say:0:1821611001:1.female: After speaking with the patients, you sense the same problem in each of them—the magic inside their bodies has fallen badly out of balance.

say:1:1821611002:1.text: However, their disguises were created with gravecalling magic, which altered how their own magic behaves. For now, you have no idea how to treat them.
say:1:1821611002:1.source_cn: 然而施加在他们身上的伪装魔法属于亡灵法术的范畴，这让他...
say:1:1821611002:1.male: However, their disguises were created with gravecalling magic, which altered how their own magic behaves. For now, you have no idea how to treat them.
say:1:1821611002:1.female: However, their disguises were created with gravecalling magic, which altered how their own magic behaves. For now, you have no idea how to treat them.

say:4:1821611004:0.text: I... hah... I brought... the doctor!
say:4:1821611004:0.source_cn: 我……呼、呼……我把医生……带过来了！

say:5:1821611005:0.text: Deadreef Shipping must've scored big this time, bringing in so many sick stowaways. I bet the bonus was more than generous.
say:5:1821611005:0.source_cn: 居然有这么多生病的偷渡者，看来这次你们暗礁航运干了一票...

say:6:1821611006:1.text: Are you here to treat patients or make jokes?!
say:6:1821611006:1.source_cn: 喂！你到底是来救人的还是来闲聊的？！

say:7:1821611007:1.text: Please, argue later. Help them first!
say:7:1821611007:1.source_cn: 是啊……先别说这些了，快想办法救人吧！

say:8:1821611008:1.text: If anything happens to even one of them, there goes my bonus!
say:8:1821611008:1.source_cn: 但凡有一个人出事，我的奖金就全打水漂了！

say:9:1821611009:0.text: Fine. Everyone calm down. I'll examine them one at a time.
say:9:1821611009:0.source_cn: 哼，知道了。一个个看，别急。

narration:11:1821611011:1.text: Only after a long while does she stroll back over to you.
narration:11:1821611011:1.male: Only after a long while does she stroll back over to you.
narration:11:1821611011:1.female: Only after a long while does she stroll back over to you.

say:12:1821611012:0.text: I'm done. I know what's causing it.
say:12:1821611012:0.source_cn: 检查完了，病因也找到了。

choice_prompt:13:1821611012.text: I'm done. I know what's causing it.
choice_prompt:13:1821611012.source_cn: 检查完了，病因也找到了。

say:14:1821611013:1.text: The symptoms are all over the place—exhaustion, despair, delusions... It's quite a mess.
say:14:1821611013:1.source_cn: 每个人的病症不同，精力不足、悲观主义、认知失调等等，情...
say:14:1821611013:1.male: The symptoms are all over the place—exhaustion, despair, delusions... It's quite a mess.
say:14:1821611013:1.female: The symptoms are all over the place—exhaustion, despair, delusions... It's quite a mess.

say:15:1821611014:1.text: But they all have the same cause: no sunlight.
say:15:1821611014:1.source_cn: 不过，病因都一样：缺乏光照。
say:15:1821611014:1.male: But they all have the same cause: no sunlight.
say:15:1821611014:1.female: But they all have the same cause: no sunlight.

say:17:1821611016:1.text: You're saying they're sick because they haven't seen the sun?
say:17:1821611016:1.source_cn: 你是说他们生病是因为晒不到太阳？

say:18:1821611017:1.text: Exactly. Sunlight isn't only good for plants, you know.
say:18:1821611017:1.source_cn: 没错。你该不会天真地以为，只有植物才需要光照吧？

say:19:1821611018:1.text: The sunless city of Novaris was never a place for the living. A short visit is fine, but stay too long and your spirit will wither away, like a sunflower deprived of sunlight.
say:19:1821611018:1.source_cn: 诺珐斯这种没有太阳的地方不适合生者生活，偶尔来度个假没...

say:20:1821611019:1.text: Many of my living coworkers develop the same symptoms after staying here too long. It's quite common.
